claim: L5 (LFP-primary analysis spec): cross-area LFP onset latency, stim condition, causal-only pipeline. Discriminates H1 (V1 leads) / H2 (FEF/PFC leads) / H3 (simultaneous/ambiguous, needs L6).
implementation: context/figures/L5_onset_latency_hierarchy/L5_onset_latency_hierarchy.py. Every pipeline stage causal by construction: single-pass Butterworth bandpass (scipy.signal.lfilter, NOT filtfilt, per omission-signal S3), full-wave rectification, linear pooling (trials then channels, L0 method a) BEFORE smoothing (safe because averaging and the causal smoother both commute as linear operators), jnwb.onset_fitting.causal_exp_smooth + fit_exponential_onset reused verbatim from the spiking onset-hierarchy fix earlier this session (artifacts/.lab/onset-hierarchy-h1h2h3-fixed-20260815.json) -- same causality-bounded-by-construction t0, same 500ms real-history extraction margin fixing the exact boundary-pinning bug class found there.
absolute_t0_caveat: Absolute t0 is shifted by the causal filter's + smoother's own group delay -- confirmed via self-test (true injected t0=60ms recovered as fit t0=197ms absolute). Only cross-area DIFFERENCES within the same band are meaningful (systematic delay cancels); this is stated explicitly in L5_stats.json's ABSOLUTE_T0_WARNING field and in the figure's own subtitle, not left for a reader to discover.
self_test: (a) Injected 80ms lag between two synthetic areas recovered as 83ms -- within 2*tau_ms=60ms tolerance, PASS. (b) Synthetic zero-lag case (identical true onset, two independent 4-session sets) returned discriminating=false (CI [-0.1,0.1]ms) -- the spec's own explicit acceptance test, PASS. Determinism also PASS.

real_run.runtime: 8m00s (6 areas x up to 6 sessions x 5 bands, ~150 causal onset fits)
real_run.result: EVERY band (theta, alpha, beta, low_gamma, high_gamma) returned H3_simultaneous_or_ambiguous (Spearman rank correlation between hierarchy position and onset time, p>=0.05 in all five). High_gamma had the tightest CIs and a qualitatively plausible early-V1 pattern (rho=0.37) but did not reach significance at n<=6 sessions/area.
real_run.reported_honestly: Per CLAUDE.md tripwire 10 ('a valid null is a result, report it') -- this is NOT spun into a false H1/H2 claim. The all-H3 result is the actual finding of this run.

implication: Per the spec's own text, an H3 result cannot by itself distinguish genuine simultaneous engagement from a shared volume-conducted field -- L6 (volume conduction control) is now not just next in the L0-L12 dependency graph but ACTIVELY REQUIRED to interpret this L5 result at all. Recommend L6 as the immediate next item.
not_yet_done: Omission-locked onset (RXRR, p2) not built -- stim (RRRR) only, stated in scope. No multiplicity correction applied across the 5 bands x 15 area-pairs = 75 pairwise comparisons shown in L5_stats.json's pairwise field -- this is descriptive per spec's 'do not conclude' posture, not a corrected inferential family.
